title: QUIZ - 57
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Determine that an ordered pair fails to satisfy a system of equations
questions.question: Is (m, a) = (4, 6) a solution to the system: \( 2m + 4a = 34 \) and \( 4m - 1a = 14 \)?

options.label: A
options.text: No, it does not satisfy the second equation.

options.label: B
options.text: Yes, it satisfies both equations.

options.label: C
options.text: No, it does not satisfy the first equation.

options.label: D
options.text: Yes, but only the second equation.

questions.explanation: Substituting into the first equation: 2(4) + 4(6) = 32, but the equation requires 34. Since \(32 \neq 34\), this is not a solution.
questions.hint: Check each equation individually; a pair that fails even one equation is not a solution to the system.

questions.learningObjective: Verify whether an ordered pair satisfies every equation in a system
questions.question: Is (n, t) = (6, -2) a solution to the system: \( 3n + 6t = 6 \) and \( 6n - 3t = 42 \)?

options.label: A
options.text: No, it fails both equations.

options.label: B
options.text: No, it fails the second equation.

options.label: C
options.text: Yes, it satisfies both equations.

options.label: D
options.text: No, it fails the first equation.

questions.explanation: Substituting into the first equation: 3(6) + 6(-2) = 6. Substituting into the second: 6(6) - 3(-2) = 42. Both check out, so it is a solution.
questions.hint: A solution to a system must satisfy every equation in the system simultaneously.

questions.concept: Graphical Meaning of a System's Solution
questions.learningObjective: Understand what a system's solution represents graphically
questions.question: What does a solution to a system of two linear equations represent graphically?

options.label: A
options.text: The point where the two lines intersect.

options.label: B
options.text: The y-intercept of the first equation only.

options.label: C
options.text: The slope of either line.

options.label: D
options.text: The area enclosed between the two lines.

questions.explanation: A solution (x, y) must satisfy both equations at once, which corresponds to the point where both lines cross on a graph.
questions.hint: Think about what point would lie on both lines simultaneously.
